items.title: MCHP Q3 CY2026 deep dive: data center design wins offset by cautious outlook and supply constraints
items.summary: Analog chipmaker Microchip Technology (NASDAQ:MCHP) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q2 2027), with sales up 42.2% year on year to $1.62 billion. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $1.61 billion was less impressive, coming in 1.4% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.97 per share was 3.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: The Chip Shortage Is Back, and Microchip Says AI Customers Are Crowding Everyone Out
items.summary: Microchip beat its own forecast, yet the stock still got hammered. The CEO says AI buyers swept through supplier factories and shoved everyone else aside, and one fix could take six months. Is this a lasting problem or a timing glitch?

items.title: Microchip Technology (MCHP) Added AI And Space Chips As Q2 Hit $1,621.5 Million
items.summary: Microchip Technology (NasdaqGS:MCHP) announced acquisitions of edge AI chip designer Hailo and radiation-hardened specialist Vorago Technologies in 2024. Vorago Technologies brings components built for harsh environments such as aerospace and defense, including high radiation and extreme temperatures.
